items.job: Diagnose stalling; repair grounds, ignition switch or power module
items.note: CarComplaints lists about $900-950 as typical for 2006.

items.job: Replace head gasket (often with timing belt and water pump)
items.note: Owners report about $800-2,900; more if the head is cracked.
CarComplaints lists about $1,140 typical when overheating damage is included.

items.t: Front crankshaft seal oil leak from crankshaft end play
items.job: Replace front seal; replace crankshaft bearings or short block if end play is out of spec
items.note: Owners report about $1,000 for crank and bearings and up to about $5,700 for an engine.

items.t: Check engine light, rough idle and burnt valves
items.job: Cylinder head valve job or head replacement

items.t: Thermostat and thermostat housing leak or stick
items.job: Replace thermostat and housing, refill coolant
items.note: CarComplaints lists about $800 typical, often including other parts tried.

items.t: Shifter cable bushing breaks, car won't go into gear
items.job: Replace shift cable bushing or shift cables
items.note: Owners report about $280-515; snap-in bushings cost $5-20.

items.t: Automatic transmission stuck in gear or failing
items.job: Repair solenoid or replace transmission with remanufactured unit
Replace clutch master/slave cylinder or clutch kit

items.job: Install dash cover or replace dash pad
items.note: CarComplaints lists about $100 typical with a cover.
